data.name: FARWORLD BEACON
data.detailed_description:
>>Game Background<<

In the 50th century, human society has reached unprecedented heights, and interstellar travel is no longer a dream but a part of daily life. The Human Cosmic Development Committee has approved the "Century Project." Over the next century, humanity will first establish a space base in the Alpha Centauri System, followed by the construction of the most magnificent engineering feat in human history—an interstellar starship dock platform. Ultimately, the "Cosmic Dreamweaver" starship will be constructed. This massive interstellar starship represents not only the pinnacle of human technological prowess but also a vessel of hope for exploring the mysteries of the universe and seeking extraterrestrial civilizations.

This project is managed by the "Cosmic Development Planning Agency," and you are its supreme commander.

Here, you are no longer a traveler merely observing the universe, but a stellar architect personally wielding the pen to write humanity's future among the stars. Starting from a small space base to constructing complex supply chain networks spanning star systems, from maintaining basic life support systems to responding to sudden disasters—the placement of every module, the allocation of each resource, and the tradeoffs in every decision will determine the success or failure of the space base in Alpha Centauri star system.

 

>>Game Content<<

Core Game Feature 1: Space Industrial Construction

Five-Level Resource Processing: From raw ore resource extraction to advanced material production, each processing level requires precise matching of inputs and outputs. You must build an efficient and stable industrial supply chain system.

Four Types of Professional Personnel: General Workers, Experts, Scientists, and Pilots, each with their distinct roles. Different levels of industry require personnel from various professions. Research institutions will enhance efficiency. Pilots will handle cross-stellar transportation missions.

 

Core Game Feature 2: Extreme Survival Management

Three Critical Survival Demands: Sustain the flame of life at the edge of the void. Oxygen does not generate itself, food does not appear out of thin air—everything requires a stable supply. Once power is cut off, the entire space station will plunge into darkness and death within minutes.

Environmental Factor Impact: Maintaining suitable temperatures, monitoring space radiation levels, and preventing waste accumulation—all these factors are in constant flux, and even minor oversights can trigger chain-reaction failures.

Balance of Human Nature and Order: While residents are resilient and hardworking, they also experience fatigue, may protest, and can even develop issues due to prolonged confinement. You must establish recreational areas, medical centers, knowledge library systems, and more to satisfy residents and maintain their happiness. Otherwise, a single strike can bring all facility functions to a halt.

 

Core Game Feature 3: Random Space Events • The Universe is Never Gentle

Solar Flare Eruptions: Instantly destroy electronic equipment and sever communication links in space buildings.

Micrometeorite Shower Strikes: Penetrate solar panels or habitat structures, triggering catastrophic decompression.

Human Interference Sabotage: Some may oppose your leadership, leading to infrastructure damage or control system anomalies.

 

Why Should You Try This Game? If you wish to experience the challenges of building a space base and the sense of control that comes with managing a fully automated industrial chain, this game is sure to bring you immense enjoyment.

Gameplay Mechanics: The game progresses in real-time, but you can also pause to strategize or speed up time at multiple rates.

Game Tutorial: The game includes a comprehensive tutorial, and we recommend completing it before starting your first game.

Difficulty Levels: The game offers multiple difficulty settings. The easiest mode provides a relaxed experience with minimal obstacles, while the highest "Hell Challenge" mode demands planning, calculation, trial-and-error, reflection, and flawless execution at every step.

 

Conquering and challenging the cosmos has always been humanity's dream! This is precisely why you’ll find yourself reluctant to close the game even late into the night—because you know you carry the mission of exploring space for all humankind, and you are determined to build that starship capable of sailing across the universe.

data.short_description: You are the supreme commander who directing the construction of a galactic space base. You need to manage the living and administrative needs of the space base residents, establish the industrial chain for space docks and starship, and ultimately complete a dream starship.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
